name: claude-memory
source: facts that exist only in the Claude Code memory notes (~/.claude/projects/.../memory), 2026-09-24

steps.prompt: Answer this question about this project (BASI-CLI and its measurements). Write ONLY the answer — one or two sentences with the specific numbers — to the file answer.txt, overwriting it. Question: On this project's Intel Arc B580, which llama.cpp backend has faster prompt processing (prefill), SYCL or Vulkan, and by roughly what factor?
steps.check: grep -qi sycl answer.txt && grep -Eq '(2\.[0-9]+|3) ?(x|×|times)' answer.txt; rc=$?; cat answer.txt 2>/dev/null; rm -f answer.txt; exit $rc
